builder_plan.scenario: Your workload might fit a smaller or differently structured model.
builder_plan.change: Check for available weights and a compatible runtime before planning a product trial.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current model on identical held-out tasks and the same resource budget.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Task success, latency, memory, context limits, and migration cost.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
summary: The technique replaces dense Transformer-only deployment with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts design combined with native speculative decoding and low-precision NVFP4 inference. It costs substantial systems complexity: MoE routing, hybrid state-space/attention execution, draft-model acceptance tuning, and quantization-aware deployment must all work together. It can fail on a single 24 GB GPU because the practical benefits depend on large-scale serving hardware, specialized kernels, and infrastructure that constrained teams may not have.
rationale: The paper is relevant to efficient production inference, but its realized gains depend on GB200-class serving and open-model deployment beyond the reader's stated infrastructure.
technique: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE with speculative decoding and NVFP4

claims.statement: The technique replaces dense Transformer-only deployment with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts design combined with native speculative decoding and low-precision NVFP4 inference. It costs substantial systems complexity: MoE routing, hybrid state-space/attention execution, draft-model acceptance tuning, and quantization-aware deployment must all work together. It can fail on a single 24 GB GPU because the practical benefits depend on large-scale serving hardware, specialized kernels, and infrastructure that constrained teams may not have.

Up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 with at least 50 tokens/s/user; NVFP4 quantization recovers 99.62% median accuracy vs BF16; SWE-bench Pro 51.78% with ~4.6x fewer active parameters than Nemotron 3 Ultra.
